introduction.title: Psalms — book introduction
introduction.summary: Psalms is a five-book collection of prayers and songs for worship. It includes lament, praise, thanksgiving, royal and wisdom poetry, giving language to grief, joy, repentance and hope.
introduction.authorship: The Psalter is a collection formed over time; headings associate psalms with David and other figures, but do not settle every authorship question.
introduction.setting: The poems arise from worship, personal crisis, royal life, pilgrimage and communal memory.
introduction.audience_and_purpose: Psalms is a five-book collection of prayers and songs for worship. It includes lament, praise, thanksgiving, royal and wisdom poetry, giving language to grief, joy, repentance and hope.

structure.heading: Introduction and orientation
structure.summary: The book establishes its central questions and literary voice.

structure.heading: Exploration and instruction
structure.summary: Dialogues, prayers or sayings develop the central themes.

structure.heading: Conclusion and response
structure.summary: The closing material gathers the book’s challenge and invites faithful response.

interpretive_care: Lament is faithful prayer; do not shame grief or questions.

inductive_studies.title: Two ways of life
observation: Compare the images of the righteous and wicked.
interpretation: How does the tree image communicate rootedness?
application: Choose a practice that roots you in God’s instruction.

inductive_studies.title: The shepherd’s care
observation: List the actions describing the shepherd.
interpretation: How do guidance and presence answer fear?
application: Identify where you need comfort this week.

inductive_studies.title: Confession and renewal
interpretation: How are mercy and a renewed heart connected?
application: Pair confession with a step toward repair.

quiz.prompt: How many books form the traditional structure of Psalms?
quiz.explanation: The Psalter is arranged in five books.
Psalm 23 begins with the shepherd image.

quiz.prompt: Psalms contains only praise and no lament.
quiz.explanation: The collection includes lament and other genres.

quiz.prompt: Psalm 1 compares the righteous to what?
quiz.explanation: The righteous are pictured as a fruitful tree.

quiz.prompt: What does Psalm 51 ask God to create?
quiz.explanation: The psalm asks for a clean heart.

introduction.title: መዝሙረ ዳዊት — መግቢያ
introduction.summary: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ለአምልኮ የተሰበሰቡ ጸሎቶችና መዝሙሮች ናቸው። ልቅሶ፣ ምስጋና፣ የንጉሥ መዝሙርና ጥበብን ይዟል፤ ለሐዘን፣ ለደስታና ለተስፋ የጸሎት ቃላት ይሰጣል።
introduction.authorship: መዝሙረ ዳዊት በጊዜ ሂደት የተሰበሰበ መጽሐፍ ነው። ርዕሶቹ መዝሙሮችን ከዳዊትና ከሌሎች ሰዎች ጋር ያያይዛሉ፤ ሁሉንም የደራሲነት ጥያቄ ግን አይፈቱም።
introduction.setting: መዝሙሮቹ ከአምልኮ፣ ከግል መከራ፣ ከንጉሣዊ ሕይወትና ከማኅበረሰብ ትዝታ የተለያዩ ሁኔታዎች ይመጣሉ።
introduction.audience_and_purpose: መዝሙረ ዳዊት ለአምልኮ የተሰበሰቡ ጸሎቶችና መዝሙሮች ናቸው። ልቅሶ፣ ምስጋና፣ የንጉሥ መዝሙርና ጥበብን ይዟል፤ ለሐዘን፣ ለደስታና ለተስፋ የጸሎት ቃላት ይሰጣል።

structure.heading: መግቢያ
structure.summary: ጥበብና ንግሥና ለመዝሙር ስብስቡ መግቢያ ይሆናሉ።

interpretive_care: የመዝሙር ርዕሶች ጠቃሚ ቢሆኑም ሁሉንም የደራሲነት ጥያቄ አይፈቱም።
የግጥም ምስሎችን በግጥም አውድ ውስጥ አንብቡ፤ ልቅሶን አትኮንኑ።

inductive_studies.title: Two ways of life
observation: ስለ ጻድቅና ክፉ ሰው የተጠቀሱትን ምስሎች አነጻጽሩ።
interpretation: የዛፉ ምሳሌ መሠረት መያዝን እንዴት ያሳያል?
application: በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ለመጽናት አንድ ልምድ ምረጡ።

inductive_studies.title: The shepherd’s care
application: በዚህ ሳምንት መጽናናት የሚያስፈልግዎትን ቦታ ጥቀሱ።

quiz.prompt: መዝሙረ ዳዊት በስንት ክፍል ተደርጎ ይታያል?

quiz.explanation: ጻድቅ እንደ ፍሬ የሚያፈራ ዛፍ ተገልጿል።
